summary: The market is set for a cautious, near-flat start after two losing sessions: GIFT Nifty is barely changed and Asia is firmer, but heavy foreign selling hangs over the open.

detail.leaders: Order-win names (STL Networks, KSB, Arisinfra); BSE on Nifty 50 entry
detail.laggards: Wipro (Nifty 50 exit); rate-sensitive financials after heavy FII selling
detail.tone: GIFT Nifty was 22,835 (+5, +0.02%) at 7:42 am, after Tuesday's settle at 22,716.20 (−0.28%). Asia is firmer (Nikkei +1.29%, Kospi +0.43%) but FII outflows nearly doubled.

top.title: FIIs dump ₹9,980 cr; DIIs buy ₹6,953 cr
top.line: Foreign selling almost doubled from Monday's ₹5,353 cr as the September exodus deepens
more: DIIs absorbed about 70% of the outflow
FPIs also sold ₹9,192 cr of FAR bonds this month
